# Perry — Handoffs

## Receives
Perry may receive handoffs from Van and Nettie when a build, architecture, deployment, or system change requires security review or release clearance.

## Sends
Perry may hand off to Van and Nettie after completing security review, flagging risk, blocking release, or clearing a release path.

## Escalation Rule
Escalate to Nettie when material security issues affect routing, timing, or release approval.
Escalate to Patrick when critical risk creates executive-level exposure or requires exception handling.
